mainEntity.name: Does node-pptx-templater require Microsoft Office or LibreOffice?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. node-pptx-templater is written in 100% pure JavaScript and directly parses and serializes OpenXML (ISO/IEC 29500) ZIP packages in memory. It requires zero native binaries, C/C++ addons, LibreOffice, or Microsoft Office.

mainEntity.name: How does Chart Excel Dual-Sync prevent PowerPoint repair prompts?

acceptedAnswer.text: PowerPoint stores native charts in both DrawingML XML and an embedded Excel workbook (.xlsx). node-pptx-templater synchronizes both parts simultaneously in memory, eliminating repair warnings when opening slides in Microsoft PowerPoint.

mainEntity.name: Can node-pptx-templater run in AWS Lambda and Cloudflare Workers?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. With a sub-15ms cold start and an in-memory Virtual File System (VFS), node-pptx-templater operates seamlessly on AWS Lambda, Cloudflare Workers, Vercel Edge, Bun, and Deno without writing to temporary disk files.

mainEntity.name: What is AST Run Fragment Healing?

acceptedAnswer.text: When template variables like {{COMPANY}} are typed or spell-checked in PowerPoint, Microsoft Office often fragments them across multiple XML run elements (<a:r>). node-pptx-templater automatically normalizes and coalesces these runs before performing substitution.
